AgentTasks.Goal: Implement a production-ready FIDO2/WebAuthn Relying Party Server in Rust with full specification compliance, using **webauthn-rs 0.5+** for all WebAuthn operations (registration, authentication, attestation verification, COSE algorithms). The server must support both registration (attestation) and authentication (assertion) flows with: Registration Flow: 1. `POST /webauthn/attestation/options` — initiate user registration 2. `POST /webauthn/attestation/result` — complete user registration Authentication Flow: 3. `POST /webauthn/assertion/options` — initiate user authentication 4. `POST /webauthn/assertion/result` — complete user authentication Additional Requirements: - FIDO Alliance Conformance Test Suite compliance - PostgreSQL integration with credential storage - TLS enforcement and security hardening - Comprehensive error handling and audit logging - User management and credential lifecycle - Docker containerization for deployment Execute tasks sequentially with validation at each step.
